title: At 13, UAE student builds AI education platform: How did he do it?

After his first project reached the Top 20 in a DDS AI challenge, ScoolBot placed fourth and later earned Gold at the International AI Awards 2026 and TeenTech Awards 2026. title: Stamping of boarding passes for immigration clearance to be discontinued from Sept 1

This initiative aims to enhance the efficiency of the travel process. Passengers have the option to present their boarding passes, either in electronic format or as a printed copy.

title: In 2005, crickets were fertilised in space; larvae hatched earlier than on Earth
content: In 2005, scientists examined cricket reproduction on the International Space Station, where embryos grew under microgravity conditions. Interestingly, larvae emerged sooner than those on Earth, suggesting that microgravity affects developmental speed while preserving key neural structures. This research is vital for comprehending how life forms adjust to lesser gravitational forces, expanding our knowledge of development beyond Earth.

title: Maine's Sand Beach was once part of JP Morgan's 117-acre wedding gift

The land was donated in 1949 by Eleanor Morgan Satterlee in memory of her mother, Louisa, after the family property was badly damaged in the 1947 fire.

title: Mark Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125 million school to shut after 10 years

Academic results fell short of state benchmarks and leadership expectations.  Around 540 students will now join the Ravenswood City Elementary School District. title: Red, orange alerts in Delhi: 15 flights diverted amidst heavy rain, thunderstorms

The surge in retail prices is attributed to stockpiling speculation and adverse weather impacting production. To mitigate this, the government is facilitating duty-free sugar imports, particularly from Brazil, with some raw sugar expected to arrive before mid-October. Current domestic supplies are predicted to meet future demands adequately.

Bakersfield secures third place at $441,009 average, while Tulare, with its quaint town atmosphere, has homes averaging $458,693. Rounding out the list is Eureka, where average prices sit at $418,081.

content: rival BJP factions clashed over a community feast, leaving four injured . the trouble began around 10.30 pm near anandapur grounds . one faction hosted a feast of mutton, katla fish and giant freshwater prawns . local BJP mandal president alias alleged the event was unauthorised .

title: Yogi vs Congress over 'fish feast' in Ayodhya: 'Even chameleon would be put to shame'
content: the controversy erupted after a video surfaced showing fish being prepared at a banquet hall in ayodhya . local religious figures objected to the food arrangements, saying the programme was taking place during the holy month of Sawan . a chameleon would be put to shame by these plight .

title: Ajit Doval in Beijing as India-China border tensions rise; what's on agenda?
content: NSA Ajit Doval arrives in Beijing for a two-day visit . he is set to hold the 25th round of special representatives' talks on the India-China boundary question . the talks come amid efforts by the two sides to gradually normalise relations .

title: Why Vijay scrapped Chennai’s second airport plan at Parandur
content: the greenfield airport project at Parandur will affect agricultural land and disrupt livelihoods of farmers and residents . the government is considering alternative locations and plans to conduct technical feasibility studies before finalising a new site . he said he visited Eganapuram and other villages on January 20, 2025 .
